development-types.name: Change of use
development-types.description:
A change to how a building or land is used with either:
- no building or engineering work
- work that would not need planning permission on its own

A change of use on a site larger than 1 hectare counts as major development.

development-types.name: Householder
development-types.description: Work to a house or the land that belongs to it. This includes work that needs planning permission and not a change of use.
